questions: Should the KMeans clustering use a fixed random state or be deterministic? If not, should the function set a random seed (e.g., random_state=0) to ensure reproducible results?
Are the 'Age' and 'Height' columns expected to be numeric (int/float) and what should happen if they contain non-numeric values (e.g., strings)?
Should the scatter plot be created even when KMeans is not applied (i.e., when filtered rows < 3)?
What should happen if the filtered DataFrame has exactly 3 rows but all values in 'Age' and 'Height' are identical, causing KMeans to potentially fail or produce degenerate clusters?
Should the function handle missing values (NaN) in the 'Age' or 'Height' columns, and if so, how (e.g., drop, fill, error)?
Is the scatter plot expected to be displayed (e.g., plt.show()) or just created and returned as an Axes object?
Should the function copy the input DataFrame before filtering to avoid modifying the original, or is modification allowed?
What should be the data type of the 'Cluster' column (e.g., int, categorical) and are there any constraints on its values (e.g., 0,1,2 only)?
